meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码、视频等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从各种来源快速生成AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Auto-build AI skills from documentation, repos, videos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate AI skills from diverse knowledge sources

howto.what: Claude 会自动判断你给的来源类型(文档站、GitHub 仓库、PDF、视频等),调用 Skill Seekers 的工具抓取内容、增强并打包成 AI 技能,需要时还能导出到向量数据库。
howto.when: 当你想从文档站、GitHub 仓库或 PDF 等知识源创建 AI 技能,想把文档转成适合大模型读取的格式,或要同步更新已有技能时触发。

say.text: 把这个文档站做成一个 AI 技能
say.note: 会先估算页面规模,再抓取并打包

say.text: 从这个 GitHub 仓库生成技能
say.note: 用 scrape_github 抓取仓库内容

say.text: 把这份 PDF 的技能导出到 Chroma

howto.what_en: Claude detects the source type you give it (docs site, GitHub repo, PDF, video, etc.), then uses Skill Seekers tools to scrape, enhance and package it into an AI skill, and export to a vector DB on request.
howto.when_en: When you want to build an AI skill from a docs site, GitHub repo, PDF or other sources, convert docs into LLM-ready formats, or sync existing skills with their source.

say_en.text: Turn this documentation site into an AI skill
say_en.note: Estimates page scope first, then scrapes and packages

say_en.text: Build a skill from this GitHub repo
say_en.note: Uses scrape_github to pull the repo

say_en.text: Export this PDF skill to Chroma
